metadata.title: Density Pass 33 -- Kershaw's Attack on the Stony Hill and Rose's Woods (Ticks 270-290)
metadata.description: Kershaw's South Carolina brigade attacking through Rose's Woods and across the Stony Hill, part of McLaws's assault that tears apart the III Corps salient. Kershaw's famous misunderstood order. The fight for the Wheatfield from the Confederate perspective -- regiments placed individually as they drive into the Union flank.

placements.notes: Kershaw's 2nd SC -- lead regiment on the right of Kershaw's assault line
8th SC -- smallest regiment, on Kershaw's far left
Graham's III Corps brigade on the Stony Hill -- about to be hit by Kershaw
Kershaw's 2nd SC charging toward the Stony Hill -- driving through Rose's Woods
3rd SC charging -- Kershaw gives the famous order that 3rd SC misunderstands, nearly causing a disaster
7th SC charging into Rose's Woods -- fighting through the trees
Graham's brigade falling back from the Stony Hill -- Kershaw is through
Sweitzer's V Corps brigade countercharging into the Wheatfield -- trying to seal the break
2nd SC on the Stony Hill -- holding the captured ground
3rd SC -- the misunderstood order has been clarified, they are back in line
Barnes's V Corps division trying to hold the Wheatfield -- Tilton's brigade in
2nd SC falling back -- Caldwell's II Corps countercharging into the Wheatfield
Caldwell's entire II Corps division countercharging -- Cross, Kelly, Zook, Brooke all in
Kershaw's 3rd SC -- trading the Stony Hill back and forth. The Wheatfield changes hands 6 times today.
